title: The mine mod
description: a little mod that add a few mines (please note this is in pre-alpha)
body:
this is the mine mod!

this mod is pretty simple to understand, BUT for those who dont know the "mine mod" adds some mines (1 so far) that explode when steped on!

there are a ton of plans for the future including a special crafting bench, defuser, admin defuser, admin console, making it suvival friendly and way more!

so far we have... 1 MINE! wait.. 1? eh its in alpha it'll add more...:

* default mine (with a mine texture and explodes like a mine)

thanks to MCreator for letting me make this mod, along with the [Speaker mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/speaker-mod-(pre-alpha)), possible without coding experence!
